basis: Tables that left the bronze scope (owner decision of Nov 24 2026, project standard: bronze loads only the data files that silver and gold need, plus the publisher dictionaries of those tables). Silver reads the tables of config/lakehouse/bronze_silver_readers.json, and gold and features read silver only. Capture still stores every file. Only the bronze load changed.
decision: The scope switch only. No load writes these tables, and no step drops or deletes an existing table from the catalog, Glue or S3: physical retirement waits for a maintained searchable inventory (owner decision Registry Q4, Nov 18 2026).
interim_record: The frozen file_metadata and stored_copies rows of these tables and the S3 manifests stay as the searchable record of what bronze held. The metadata build carries the rows forward unchanged. Each entry keeps the group and the dataset_ids and member_pattern selectors it had in the bronze table map, so the source registry and the source verification log still derive their evidence from the same selectors.
trigger: The first new capture in a leaving collection, or raw read acceptance.
follow_up: The source_objects inventory (registry design v3 section 4.4), then physical retirement.
